validation.summary: 11 defect(s) detected. Structural score: 0.912. Coverage score: 0.962. Hallucination score: 1.000. Semantic score: 1.000. Overall score: 0.892.

review.overall_assessment: The diagram covers most CTS transaction flows and support activities, but it still omits the terminal-user usability requirements and contains several unsupported end states in exception branches.

defects.description: Action N24 is a dead end after handling a sell deal exception.
defects.evidence: R35 requires the sell transaction to handle deal exceptions; the diagram shows N24 'Handle sell deal exceptions' with no outgoing edge or termination, so the exception path does not continue to any next workflow step or explicit completion.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N24 to an appropriate follow-up step or terminate the exception path explicitly if the use case ends there.

defects.description: Action N25 is a dead end after handling the sell no-match exception.
defects.evidence: R36 requires handling the case where no matched stock exists; the node 'Report no matched stock for sell instruction' has no outgoing edge or final state, leaving the exception branch unfinished.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N25 to a completion or terminal node consistent with the intended sell exception flow.

defects.description: Action N30 is a dead end after handling cancel suspension.
defects.evidence: R40 requires the cancel transaction to suspend all operations when operations are suspended; N30 implements this handling but has no outgoing edge or terminal completion.
defects.suggested_action: Add a continuation or final termination for the cancel suspended branch.

defects.description: Action N31 is a dead end after handling an already implemented instruction.
defects.evidence: R41 requires handling the case where the instruction concerned has already been implemented; the diagram stops at N31 without a successor or explicit end.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N31 to an explicit termination or next step for the cancel exception branch.

defects.description: Action N32 is a dead end after handling no matched instruction to cancel.
defects.evidence: R42 requires handling the case where no matched instruction exists to be cancelled; N32 has no outgoing edge or final node.
defects.suggested_action: Add a proper continuation or termination for N32.

defects.description: Action N36 is a dead end after handling suspended save-trade operations.
defects.evidence: R45 requires the save-trade-information use case to suspend operations when suspended; the branch ends at N36 without a successor or explicit end.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N36 to an explicit end or next relevant step.

defects.description: Action N37 is a dead end after handling no matched stock in save-trade flow.
defects.evidence: R46 requires handling the no-matched-stock case; N37 has no outgoing edge or termination.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N37 to a completion or terminal node.

defects.description: Action N43 is a dead end after handling suspended query operations.
defects.evidence: R51 requires the query use case to suspend all operations when suspended; the diagram ends this branch at N43 without a continuation or explicit end.
defects.suggested_action: Add a continuation or final node for N43.

defects.description: Action N44 is a dead end after handling an invalid query.
defects.evidence: R52 requires handling invalid queries; N44 has no outgoing edge or terminal completion.
defects.suggested_action: Connect N44 to an explicit completion or end state.

defects.description: Requirement R10 is not traced to any diagram element.
defects.evidence: R10 states that the CTS shall provide easy operations to terminal users. No node or edge in the diagram represents the usability/operation-simplicity requirement.
defects.suggested_action: Add a diagram element or annotation that explicitly captures the terminal-user operations requirement.

defects.description: Requirement R11 is not traced to any diagram element.
defects.evidence: R11 requires terminal-user operations to be confined to mouse clicks and keyboard inputs. The diagram contains no element representing this interaction constraint.
defects.suggested_action: Add a diagram element or note that traces the mouse-click and keyboard-input constraint.

strengths: The core buy, sell, cancel, save-trade, and query use-case flows are all represented.
Instruction reception, analysis, division, matching, and message sending are included.
The diagram distinguishes main success paths from exception branches for several use cases.
Support/maintenance and overload considerations are represented as separate activity nodes.
